name: Playful Starts
description: A gentle, play-based introduction to AI-assisted learning tools for children ages 3-7, run alongside a caregiver.
timeline: 8-week rolling cohort, one 45-minute session per week
successIndicators: Caregiver-reported confidence using tools at home

name: Sensory-Friendly Classroom Kit
description: A classroom starter kit and short teacher training for building sensory-friendly, AI-supported learning corners.
timeline: Self-paced setup, ongoing support for the school year
successIndicators: Increased on-task time during quiet corner use

name: Voice & Choice
description: AAC and communication-device onboarding for non-verbal youth ages 8-15, paired with a peer mentor.

name: Focus Forward
description: Executive-function coaching for teens with ADHD, supported by an adaptive task-planning app.
timeline: 10-week program, one session per week plus daily app use

name: Family Toolkit Orientation
description: A single orientation session that helps families choose and set up the right free Elevate Minds tools for their child.
successIndicators: Family leaves with a configured tool
Reduced support-request volume in first 30 days

name: Caregiver Support Circle
description: A recurring peer-support circle for parents and caregivers of children with disabilities, with an optional AI-literacy segment.
